response.sql: WITH exam_data AS (SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` FROM Examination e INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE e.`aCL IgM` IS NOT NULL), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) as mean_acl_igm FROM exam_data), with_deviations AS (SELECT ed.ID, ed.SEX, ed.`aCL IgM`, ed.`aCL IgM` - om.mean_acl_igm as deviation FROM exam_data ed CROSS JOIN overall_mean om), sex_avg_deviations AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) as sex_avg_deviation FROM with_deviations WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SEX), filtered_data AS (SELECT wd.ID, wd.SEX, wd.`aCL IgM`, wd.deviation, sad.sex_avg_deviation, wd.deviation - sad.sex_avg_deviation as above_sex_avg FROM with_deviations wd INNER JOIN sex_avg_deviations sad ON wd.SEX = sad.SEX WHERE wd.deviation > sad.sex_avg_deviation) SELECT ID, SEX, `aCL IgM`, deviation, above_sex_avg FROM filtered_data ORDER BY above_sex_avg DESC LIMIT 10
